user.title: Telegram account
user.description: The integration talks to the suppliers' bots from your own Telegram account. Create the API id and hash at my.telegram.org → API development tools. Telegram then sends a login code to your Telegram app.

code.title: Login code
code.description: Enter the code Telegram has just sent to {phone}. Telegram says it went: {delivery}.

password.title: Two-step verification
password.description: This account has a cloud password. Enter it to finish logging in.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Telegram session for {phone} no longer works (revoked in Settings → Devices, or expired). Submit to log in again.

method.title: How to log in
method.description: Telegram sometimes doesn't deliver login codes to new third-party apps. Logging in by QR code needs no code.

menu_options.qr: Scan a QR code with the phone
menu_options.send_code: Send a login code to the Telegram app

qr.title: Scan the QR code
qr.description: On the phone open Telegram → Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device and scan this code. Then press Submit. The code is valid for about 30 seconds; if it expires, Submit shows a new one.

error.invalid_api_id: Telegram rejected the API id / hash.
error.invalid_phone: Telegram doesn't know this phone number.
error.code_expired: The code expired; a new one has been sent.
error.flood_wait: Telegram asks to wait before requesting another code. Try again later.
error.payment_required: Telegram wants a payment (Premium) before it sends a login code to this number to a third-party app. Log in from an official app first, or try later.
error.email_required: Telegram requires a login email for this account before it sends codes to third-party apps. Set up a login email in Telegram → Settings → Privacy and Security, then try again.
error.qr_expired: The QR code expired before it was scanned. Here is a new one.
error.qr_not_scanned: Telegram hasn't confirmed the scan yet. Scan the code, then press Submit.

abort.already_configured: This Telegram account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That's a different Telegram account than the one this entry belongs to.

init.description: The YASNO address, the Київводоканал account and the Київтеплоенерго login enable the web APIs (faster than the bot). Leave them empty to use only the bot.{detail}

data_description.yasno_account: Особовий рахунок, as you type it into @Yasnoonlinebot.
data_description.yasno_city: As on yasno.ua; Київ if empty.
data_description.yasno_street: The street name or a unique part of it, without «вул.».
data_description.yasno_house: Exactly as on yasno.ua, e.g. 4 or 4 А.
data_description.yasno_apartment: With the address, readings go through YASNO's web API, and the bot is only the fallback. The address is looked up once when you save; the account it finds must match the account number above.
data_description.komunalka_address: Only needed if @komunalkaua_bot lists more than one address: a part of the address button's text.
data_description.kvk_account: Особовий рахунок КК ЦКС from the water bill (10 digits). Cold water and hot-water drainage go to Київводоканал's public form; checked when you save.
data_description.kte_email: Login of kte.kmda.gov.ua/my-cabinet. With the password, hot water goes through the cabinet; the login is checked when you save.
data_description.kte_password: Stored in Home Assistant (and its backups), like the Telegram session.

error.yasno_address_incomplete: Fill in street, house and apartment, or leave all three empty.
error.yasno_account_required: Needed to check the account YASNO finds at the address.
error.yasno_cannot_connect: YASNO's web API didn't answer. Try again later.
error.yasno_account_mismatch: At this address YASNO has a different account.
error.kvk_cannot_connect: Київводоканал's form didn't answer. Try again later.
error.kte_login_incomplete: Fill in both the e-mail and the password, or leave both empty.
error.kte_login_failed: Couldn't log in to the Київтеплоенерго cabinet.

submit.name: Submit readings
submit.description: Send meter readings to a supplier's bot. Every step checks the bot's answer; anything unexpected stops the run. Returns what was sent and the conversation.

config_entry_id.name: Telegram account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one account.

bot.name: Bot
bot.description: yasno: readings {"day": …, "night": …} in kWh (whole numbers are sent). komunalka: readings by meter serial number in m³ (two decimals, rounded down).

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Go through the conversation up to the point where the number would be sent, and stop there.

max_increase.name: Largest increase
max_increase.description: A reading may exceed the bot's previous one by at most this much. Defaults: 3000 kWh (YASNO), 50 m³ (Комуналка).

via.name: Way
via.description: auto: the suppliers' sites, the bot for what they didn't take; api or telegram: only that way.

fallback.name: Bot as fallback now
fallback.description: Off: a supplier's site that gave no usable answer (after two quick retries) isn't handed to the bot; its items wait for a later run (result «pending»). Suppliers without a site set up still go through the bot.
